Prove Linux watchdog and MCU behavior under the exact intended userspace transition; maintain independently verified liveness.
Obtain writer-specific completion/quiesce acknowledgments including detached persistence workers, catalog, grid, database and shared-memory setters.
Prove supervisor cannot respawn/adopt a writer during the window; confirm exit, descendants, fd/mmap/shared-memory references and identity (not PID/name alone).
Establish coherent backup/durability/cache invalidation with consistency lane before modifying any file.
Re-establish correct startup selection and plugin ownership; verify all required writers, heartbeat producers and end-to-end load/result coherence before releasing command gates.
